engine.name: Elektron Analog Rytm MKII
engine.description: Elektron Analog Rytm MKII drum machine: every parameter of its manual's MIDI appendix, as the controllers and NRPNs it prints, on the track, FX and performance channels, the machines' parameters described on the synth parameters they set.

sources.title: Analog Rytm MKII User Manual, OS 1.74
sources.notes: MIDI appendix read by tools/profiles/elektron/read-elektron-midi.mjs from Analog-Rytm-MKII-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.74_260930.pdf (sha256 5f43be8ba948c1e8c947f8775d0eb215398d6c142a7731583c26157c3b504081), https://www.elektron.se/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Analog-Rytm-MKII-User-Manual_ENG_OS1.74_260930.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/elektron/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/elektron/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI appendix, with its printed name, sent on the CC it prints (a 14-bit pair where it prints an LSB), or its NRPN where it prints no CC. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The appendix prints no ranges: each parameter takes what its controller carries, 0 - 127 (0 - 16383 for a pair). What a value shows, and the values of a setting chosen from a list, are in the parameter's chapter of the manual.
The channel variable is a track's channel (track 1's by default): the parameters go to that track. Set it to the AUTO channel to edit whichever track is active.
The fxChannel variable is 16 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's FX track channel (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS, TRACK 1–12, FX) setting.
The perfChannel variable is 15 here: the manual prints no default for it; set it to the instrument's PERF CHANNEL (SETTINGS > MIDI CONFIG > CHANNELS) setting.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers (or NRPNs, as its PARAM OUTPUT setting says) when its knobs are turned
